Tests used real UI at https://ivf-lead-ops.preview.emergentagent.com with caller16 and admin credentials, plus Playwright route delay (750ms) for GET /api/* to force interrupted reads. First combined script completed all caller checks but failed during logout/admin handoff due a test automation login click stability issue; admin flows were rerun in separate corrected scripts and passed. One false assertion expected a title-case KPI label; corrected script verified upper-case dashboard KPI text and Reports pivot render.
rca_of_the_issue: The prior failure mode was cancellation of in-flight route GETs surfacing as unhandled axios CanceledError on pages without local catch handlers, triggering React's dev overlay and freezing navigation. The current interceptor swallows cancellations globally by returning a never-settling promise, while route changes abort previous-route GETs to free per-host connections. Preview cannot reproduce production Cloudflare 520 directly, but rapid navigation under artificially delayed reads no longer surfaces CanceledError or hangs.
